title: glyceria fluitans subsp. obtusiflora
intro: Glyceria fluitans subsp. obtusiflora, commonly known as Floating Sweet Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is a perennial aquatic plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from damage. The bioactive constituents of Floating Sweet Grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and immune system support.
